explanation: The four original dataset endpoints described by the supplied OpenAPI document remain unavailable. This snapshot uses the complete 39-role / 38-course catalogue bundled in backup/data, with the six Digital Media roles replaced by the versions currently published by BIICF, plus the specification's six sectors and a separate COSMO-based Business & Leadership study guide.
note: Digital Media progression, entry requirements, skills and recommended training were checked against the official BIICF pages on 27 October 2026. Other roles and all courses come from the bundled backup/data snapshot. Business study progression, potential careers and leadership topics were checked against official COSMO pages on the same date and are not presented as a BIICF career ladder. Run node scripts/refresh-data.mjs after the source publishes its datasets to replace the snapshot with a validated live copy.
